verdict.rationale: Terraform documents a native `terraform test` framework for validating module changes. Tests run against test-specific, short-lived resources, "preventing any risk to your existing infrastructure or state". Since v1.7.0, provider data can be mocked so tests run without real infrastructure, and `test` also emits machine-readable JSON output for automation. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the testing framework in practice.
